name: Life spaceship 5deb47c2 on 3-uniform tiling k3-039
description: A period-20 spaceship in Conway's Life (B3/S23) on the 3-uniform tiling k3-039, with touching neighbours, 7 to 21 cells, moving five lattice steps every 20 generations (c/4). It runs the same way in the 8,192 rules from B3/S23 to B3,7,9,10,11,12/S2,3,6,7,8,9,10,11,12. JETCARP's Life census met it in 36.0% of its soups on this tiling. It contains a perturbed phase of the smaller ship c64f95a0f35606dd.
